title: Sparse signs
prompt:
Create a REVISED HNDRD icon concept board in response to explicit rejection of previous boards as FAR TOO DETAILED. The user wants On's very simple, minimal, abstract pictograms. They liked STRING CONSTRUCTION, STRING GAUGE and MAX TENSION as ideas. This revision must make a dramatic reduction in visual information. Think sparse signs, not miniature products.
REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 is the user's original On screenshot. ONLY its bottom three icons are the aesthetic target. Study its cropped lacing arch and open heel outline: most details are omitted. Image 2 is a REJECTED previous HNDRD board, attached ONLY to identify the liked string-gauge and string-construction concepts. Do NOT follow image 2's density, large drawings, full shoes, full bags, gridded rackets, tread patterns, stitched panels, dimension diagrams or layouts that make drawings huge.
Canvas 1600x1200 landscape 4:3, white. Heading top left "HNDRD / LESS, BETTER" with provided subtitle below. Exactly twelve small black outline icons arranged as 4 columns x 3 rows on a spacious plain white page. Each icon occupies only an 80x80 optical area inside a very generous cell; don't enlarge icons to fill cells. Nominal 2px stroke on an 80 unit grid. Keep equal optical weight and open negative space. Labels plain small readable uppercase sans serif. No frames around cells, no shaded fills, no shadows, no perspective, no long footer, no size-sample drawings, no ornament. Tiny footer "EXPLORATION / NO PRODUCT VALUES ASSIGNED".
Exact reading-order labels: row1 WEIGHT / BALANCE / SHAFT FLEX / MAX TENSION. row2 STRING GAUGE / STRING CONSTRUCTION / OUTSOLE / SUPPORT STRUCTURE. row3 VENTILATION / COMPARTMENTS / SHOE STORAGE / BAG DIMENSIONS.
Very important icon constraints:
WEIGHT: one original slim feather suggestion, curved outer contour, a center line and just two short barbs. NOT fully drawn feather plumage, no measurement guide.
BALANCE: one horizontal beam resting on one small open triangular fulcrum. NO racket, NO handle, NO suspended scale, NO arrow.
SHAFT FLEX: a single gently bowed line next to a short straight dashed reference line. NO racket head, grip, shaft thickness, arrow or engineering apparatus.
MAX TENSION: a single cropped open racket-head arc with a sparse string grid, at most THREE vertical and THREE horizontal straight strings, optionally two very small opposing arrows. NO handle, NO double rim, NO dense tennis-racket mesh.
STRING GAUGE: a simple circle crossed by one diameter indicator. Keep the favored clear cross-section idea; NO trailing cylinder or perspective, NO repeated reference guides.
STRING CONSTRUCTION: one outer circle containing just THREE to FIVE small filament circles. Keep the favored clear cross-section idea; NO long cable, NO fanned strands, NO exploded view, NO dense bundle.
OUTSOLE: only a cropped pair of shallow parallel sole curves with at most two small notches. NO complete shoe footprint, NO lugs pattern, NO tread grid, NO brand-specific sole.
SUPPORT STRUCTURE: one simple arch on a short baseline. NO shoe drawing, NO plate diagram, NO implied anatomical protection.
VENTILATION: only THREE short parallel airflow curves. NO textile patch, NO woven mesh, NO dots pattern, NO arrowheads.
COMPARTMENTS: one very simple open-top container outline and two internal dividing strokes. NO bag silhouette, NO strap, NO zip, NO lid, NO 3D/perspective.
SHOE STORAGE: one open-top U-shaped pocket outline containing one extremely spare low shoe/sole suggestion made of two curves. NO lacing, NO tread, NO zip, NO handles, NO floating second shoe.
BAG DIMENSIONS: one minimal corner outline and two orthogonal measurement indicators. NO complete bag, NO handles or zipper, NO third dimension.
These are intentionally ABSTRACT attribute signs with labels carrying the precise meaning. 2-5 strokes per icon except max tension and construction (up to 8). Actively leave most of each cell blank. If something is not necessary to distinguish the attribute, omit it. Every icon must survive being reduced to 32px. Do not add detail to look impressive. Draw original paths, not literal copies of On artwork.
Subtitle exactly SPARSE SIGNS. Follow the twelve specified glyph constructions strictly. Friendly smooth curves and exact straight measurement strokes; utterly sparse shapes. This is the reference correction board. No rule lines between rows; white space does all grouping.
